messages.content: What is the equivalent of $20 in British Pounds?

function.name: weather_in_location

message.content:
The exchange rate between the U.S. dollar (USD) and the British pound (GBP) fluctuates constantly. As of the most recent data, 1 USD is roughly equivalent to about 0.78 GBP. Using that rate:

\[
\$20 \times 0.78 \text{ GBP/USD} \approx £15.60
\]

So, $20 is approximately £15.60. Keep in mind that the exact amount can vary slightly depending on the day’s market rate and any fees your bank or payment service might charge.
